outcome: preeclampsia (PE) requiring delivery at < 37 weeks' gestation (preterm-PE)
cohort: The study included consecutive women with singleton pregnancies attending for their routine hospital visit at 30-34 weeks' gestation in 3 maternity hospitals.
finding: Combined screening by maternal factors and biomarkers in the early third trimester predicted 98% of preterm-PE and 49% of term-PE, at a 5% false-positive rate.
